Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was diagnosed with concussion. Over the
course of care, the patient attended 26 visits. Presenting symptoms included headache, dizziness, and difficulty
concentrating, and the reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash described.
Neurological examination showed some findings that support the diagnosis, while other testing returned within normal
limits. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known. Treatment followed a typical progression of symptom
monitoring, vestibular and cognitive rest guidance, and graded return to activity. Visit frequency decreased steadily as
symptoms resolved and the patient improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no
duplicated or repeated entries.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
